create_node_class: create a Node subclass with topic class variables for graph computation
define_publisher_method: define an async method with @publisher decorator to publish messages to a topic
define_subscriber_method: define a method with @subscriber decorator to receive messages from a topic
define_main_entry_point: define a method with @main decorator as the graph entry point called at startup
review_node_metaclass: review the NodeMeta metaclass that validates @publisher @subscriber and @main decorators on Node methods
